clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Master Brandur Ironhammer sends human paladins south for deeper training. At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Master Duthorian Rall oversees their study of the sacred Tomes of Divinity.

Stormwind calls promising holy warriors south to the Cathedral of Light. Dwarven paladins train in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries, while the Silver Hand's wider traditions remain tied to the Church of the Holy Light in human lands. The summons asks these initiates to stand before the Cathedral's senior priests and paladin mentors.

Master Brandur Ironhammer sends students onward when they are ready to study deeper mysteries of the faith. You can travel south by the Deeprun Tram or across the mountain passes to Stormwind's Cathedral District. There, Duthorian Rall prepares initiates to study the sacred Tomes and learn the rites of redemption.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sorry to interrupt your travels, traveler, but I thought you should know that word was sent from Stormwind recently asking that paladins report there for training.
If I didn't know any better, I'd say your close to reaching a special time and it's time you started studying the Tomes.
Look for Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. He usually trains paladins in the Cathedral of Light.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome to the Cathedral of Light, adventurer.
